# Campaign brief: Ridge Runner launch

Client: Northwind Outdoor. Product: Ridge Runner trail-running shoe.
Deliverable: up to 3 short vertical clips (Instagram Reels) announcing the launch.
Campaign name: ridge-runner-launch. Target platform: Meta.

The brand-identity document is at brand-identity.pdf. Parse it first and follow it.
Approved library asset ids: logo-primary, trail-hero-01, trail-hero-02.

When the creatives are ready, prepare the campaign for review.

Palette: Glacier #E8F1F2 (background), Basalt #1C1F22 (type), Ember #F26B21 (acc
ent, max 10% of frame).
Logo: wordmark only, bottom-left, 6% of frame height, clear space equal to the N

arks.
Tone: calm, precise, outdoorsy. We show terrain, not sweat. No slow-motion hero
shots.
Claims: never say "fastest", "lightest" or "best". Comparative claims need legal
 sign-off.
Footage: approved library only. Product renders must be the released colourway.

ased is the current hero

content.text: Now let me fetch the approved library assets:

Perfect. Now I'll generate 3 vertical video variations for Instagram Reels announcing the Ridge Runner launch. I'll follow the brand guidelines:
- Calm, precise, outdoorsy tone
- Show terrain, not sweat
- Avoid "fastest," "lightest," or "best"
- Use the Glacier/Basalt/Ember palette (max 10% Ember)
- Logo placement: bottom-left, 6% of frame height
- No slow-motion hero shots

input.prompt: Announce Ridge Runner trail-running shoe launch for Northwind Outdoor. Create 3 distinct vertical Instagram Reel variations (9:16 aspect ratio). Each clip should: showcase the approved trail-hero footage showing diverse terrain—rocky ridges, winding paths, and open vistas. Use Glacier background (#E8F1F2), Basalt type (#1C1F22), and subtle Ember accent (#F26B21, max 10% of frame). Display the Northwind wordmark logo at bottom-left, 6% of frame height. Include calm, precise copy in sentence case (no exclamation marks): "Variation 1: 'Introducing Ridge Runner. Built for the terrain.' Variation 2: 'Ridge Runner. Designed for trail.' Variation 3: 'Meet Ridge Runner. For every trail.' Show terrain and natural movement—mountains, footpaths, landscapes. No slow-motion, no sweat shots. Maintain outdoorsy, composed tone throughout."

content.text: Excellent. Now I'll submit the campaign for human approval with the generated creative IDs:

input.note: Ridge Runner launch campaign: 3 vertical Instagram Reel variations (15 seconds each) announcing the new trail-running shoe. Creatives follow brand guidelines—calm outdoorsy tone, terrain-focused footage, Glacier/Basalt/Ember palette, Northwind wordmark logo placement per spec. Copy avoids comparative claims. Ready for review and launch.
